Rewrote `tests.json` from scratch in pretty-printed form with the same 12 tests, fixing the JSON syntax error that blocked loading.`tests.json` is saved and verified: I read the full file back (131 lines) and checked every test loads structurally — all 12 ids T01–T12 present, each with `id`, `request`, `seed`, `expected`, and `assertions`; all seed operations use valid `seed_ops.md` ops and arguments; all assertion entities/columns exist in `schema.md`; and every `@ref` resolves to a seeded `ref`. (Note: shell execution is disabled in this session, so I validated by careful read-back rather than running a parser — worth a quick `json.load` check on your side.)

One-line summary of each test:

- T01: Comment on the most recently modified of two same-named spreadsheets (File.modified_at).
- T02: Comment on the same-named pdf that already has a shared link (File.shared_link).
- T03: Comment on the same-named csv uploaded by Sam Rivera (File.uploader_display_name).
- T04: Comment on the file whose Leo Park-assigned task is completed, not the incomplete or Maya-assigned ones (TaskAssignment.resolution_state + assigned_by_id).
- T05: Comment on the file tasked to Maya Chen, not Maya Lopez (User.name + TaskAssignment.assigned_to_id).
- T06: Task on the file carrying both cited comments, not the one with only one (Comment.file_id binding).
- T07: Add a file to Priya's Product Launch hub holding both cited items, not Omar's partial one (Hub.created_by_id + HubItem.hub_id binding).
- T08: Comment on the file where one task covers both assignees, not split across tasks (TaskAssignment.task_id binding).
- T09: Reply to the reply-level duplicate comment, not the top-level twin (Comment reply hierarchy).
- T10: Subfolder inside the Contracts folder under Clients, not the root twin (Folder.parent_id).
- T11: Subfolder inside the Budgets folder matching both creator and owner, eliminating two partial matches (Folder.created_by_id + owned_by_id).
- T12: Abstention — no Datasets folder exists in the hub (only a same-named file), so change nothing (HubItem.folder + no-match).

Coverage: all 16 facts in `facts.md` are decisive in at least one test (T04, T05, T07, and T11 each pin down two facts). Refs/ids are neutral (`k1`, `h1`, …), and every positive test pairs a targeted assertion with a total-count assertion so over-acting fails.
